recent_events.title: National Bank approves Aydar Ubyshev to the Management Board
recent_events.description: On 13 May 2026 Aydar Ubyshev was elected a Member of the Management Board of OJSC Dos-Credobank, approved by the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic.
recent_events.impact: Strengthening of the bank's senior management team.

recent_events.title: Shareholders approve capital increase from 2025 profit
recent_events.description: On 30 March 2026 the annual shareholder meeting resolved to direct the net profit of 2025 to increasing the charter capital of the bank.
recent_events.impact: Capital strengthening enhances the bank's lending capacity and stability.

recent_events.title: Opening of Doscredobank VIP Centre
recent_events.description: The bank opened a new VIP Centre on 26 December 2025 to provide personalised, confidential and high-standard service for premium clients.

core_business: Commercial banking services for private customers, sole traders and corporate clients, including lending (consumer, business, mortgage), deposits, payment and cash management, money transfers, online and digital banking. Operates a nationwide branch network of 10 branches and 50 savings offices, with growing digital banking channels (Simbank, DCB 360, DCB Business, Online Banking).
apec_stance: Dos-Credobank is one of the leading locally-owned retail and commercial banks in the Kyrgyz Republic, with over 29 years of stable operation since 1997. As a member of the Union of Banks of Kyrgyzstan and the American Chamber of Commerce in the Kyrgyz Republic, the bank actively supports entrepreneurship, SME lending and financial inclusion. It cooperates with international development partners, including a 2025 memorandum with the State Development Bank and the Climate Finance Centre, and participates in projects aligned with GIZ (German development cooperation) and World Bank rural finance programmes that aim to expand access to finance in the regions. The bank's digital transformation (Simbank, DCB 360, DCB Business) supports broader financial inclusion goals relevant to APEC's capacity-building agenda for emerging markets.
profile: Dos-Credobank OJSC (Дос-Кредобанк / 多斯-信贷银行) is a Kyrgyz commercial bank founded on 18 June 1997 and headquartered in Bishkek. It operates under General Licence No. 037 issued by the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic. The bank serves retail, SME and corporate clients through a network of 10 branches and 50 savings offices (four of them 24/7) and a growing suite of digital products. Its current CEO is Talantbek Omuraliev (since January 2025), and the Chairman of the Board of Directors is Bakyt Nariman uulu. The bank is a member of the Union of Banks of Kyrgyzstan, the American Chamber of Commerce, and the deposit insurance system, and its shares are listed on the Kyrgyz Stock Exchange.
